name: 020-chat-structured-json
description: Chat-completions request with response_format=json_object plus a JSON schema. Asserts the assistant's content parses as JSON and conforms to the supplied schema.

messages.content: Reply with a JSON object only. No prose.
Return an object with fields city (string), country (string), population (integer >= 0) for Paris, France.

ref_outputs.notes: Today `response_format` is not yet honored by NvEngineChat (it falls through to free-form decode). The structural assertion in placeholder mode is: route accepts the request body without rejecting `response_format` as an unknown field (serde permits unknown keys via #[serde(default)] on other fields; this fixture is the regression gate for that). When grammar-constrained decode lands the schema-match assertion turns on.
